nonBlockingIssues.description: Duplicate export-from blocks for './lib/constants.js' in barrel re-exports (line 261 and line 263). Functionally correct but could be consolidated.
Unused chmodSync import in lib/factory-crypto.js. File permissions handled by writeFileAtomic from ./fs.js.
Misleading module docstring referencing constants dependency that is never imported.
Unreachable try/catch around Buffer.from(base64) — Node.js silently handles invalid base64 chars. Actual validation is via key length check.
isValidFactoryAccount only checks label+accountId, unlike Codex which also requires tokens. Reasonable design since Factory accounts may lack tokens.
Factory uses camelCase token fields (accessToken/refreshToken) vs Codex shorthand (access/refresh). Intentional from readAuthV2Files output mapping.
computeBillingPeriod accepts fractional billingDay values (e.g., 1.5) — Date constructor truncates, but could be rejected for strictness.
Date arithmetic uses local timezone. Low risk for a CLI tool with day-level billing period granularity.
Unused 'flags' parameter in buildFactoryUsageLines — existing Codex/Claude display builders don't accept flags.
No-color test is vacuously true — buildFactoryUsageLines never emits ANSI codes (printBar uses unicode chars).
Duplicate billing-day index computation in shuvquota.js main() (billingDayIdx vs billingDayArgIdx).
handleFactory prints explicit error for unknown subcommands while handleCodex/handleClaude silently show help. Better UX but inconsistent.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the flag-with-value parsing pattern in main(). Currently --billing-day N requires manual indexOf + Set exclusion logic. If more flags-with-values are added (e.g., --output-format, --timeout), a general parsing utility or documented pattern should be established.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: shuvquota.js lines 52-60 (billingDayIdx parsing) and 74-80 (flagsWithValues set). factory-quota-handlers review noted this will become unwieldy with more such flags.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document that Factory uses camelCase token field names (accessToken/refreshToken) from readAuthV2Files, unlike Codex shorthand (access/refresh). Future factory-tokens.js workers need to use the correct field names when building FACTORY_TOKEN_FIELDS.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: factory-accounts review found lib/factory-accounts.js:121 uses accessToken/refreshToken vs lib/codex-accounts.js:78 using access/refresh. This was a design choice from readAuthV2Files output, but it's not documented.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: The TDD skill's RED phase instruction ('Write Tests First, run to confirm FAIL') doesn't account for new module creation. When creating a brand new lib/*.js module, the barrel re-exports and a stub module file must exist before tests can parse. Skill should clarify that creating a module stub + barrel re-exports is a prerequisite before the RED phase for new modules.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Observed in both factory-constants and factory-crypto reviews. Workers created implementation first because test imports would fail without the module and barrel re-exports existing. factory-crypto handoff explicitly noted this deviation.
